Karibu, Welcome
Olkarien Eco Safari Lodge is our flagship property in the heart of the Serengeti, offering an unparalleled blend of luxury and sustainability. Our 25 spacious safari rooms are designed with both comfort and environmental consciousness in mind, featuring solar power and eco-friendly amenities.
Located in the Seronera area of Central Serengeti, the camp provides year-round access to exceptional wildlife viewing. The area is famous for its resident predators, making it one of the best places in Africa to witness the drama of the African bush.
Our facilities include a swimming pool for relaxation after game drives, a full-service spa, and spacious family accommodations for multi-generational travel. The Honeymoon Suite offers the ultimate romantic safari experience.

See and Do Discover what awaits at Safari Lodge
Centrally situated as it is, Olkarien Eco Safari Lodge promises days filled with adventure as you set off to all points of the compass to view the diverse and abundant wildlife. There is also ample time to relax between activities.
Game Drive
Setting out each day in the company of an experienced and qualified guide, the twice-daily game drives promise guests a fascinating insight into the Serengeti ecosystem, while traveling in our comfortable, custom-made safari vehicles.
Whether witnessing the patient stalk of a lioness, or peaceful pastoral panoramas populated by vast herds of antelope, these excursions create the memories that epitomize safari. Our guides are experts in tracking wildlife and understanding animal behavior, ensuring you get the best possible viewing opportunities.
Morning drives typically depart at dawn when animals are most active, while afternoon drives continue until sunset, offering magical golden-hour photography opportunities.

Every camp and lodge above is Tanzanian-owned, positioned across the Northern Circuit rather than clustered in one park — Enkirari Wilderness Camp and Enkutoto Migration Camp follow the Great Migration through the Serengeti, Naserian Safari Camp and Olkarien Eco Safari Lodge sit in and around the Ngorongoro highlands, and Serian Tarangire Camp overlooks Tarangire s elephant corridors. That spread is deliberate: it means a multi-night stay can move between ecosystems — open plains, crater floor, riverine woodland — without changing operators or losing continuity in guiding and service.
Use the map and filters above to narrow by destination, property type, or dates, or open a property page directly for room counts, rate inclusions, and photos. Every rate shown is a direct rate — booking here means no OTA commission baked into the price and a reservations team that already knows the property, not a call center reading from a script.

Good to Know
Frequently Asked Questions
How many camps and lodges does Acacia Collections operate?
5 properties across 4 destinations in Tanzania s Northern Circuit — Arusha, Ngorongoro Conservation Area, Serengeti National Park, Tarangire National Park, with rates starting from $284.40 per night.
Is it cheaper to book directly with Acacia Collections instead of an OTA?
Yes. Every rate shown on this page is a direct rate — there s no OTA commission baked into the price, and changes to dates, rooms, or guest counts go through a reservations team that already knows the property, not a call-center script.
Are the properties eco-certified or solar-powered?
2 of 5 properties are solar-powered and 1 are eco-certified — filter by "Eco-Certified" on the map above to see which.
Can I combine multiple camps and lodges into one Northern Circuit safari?
Yes — the properties are deliberately spread across the circuit rather than clustered in one park, so a multi-night stay can move between ecosystems (open plains, crater floor, riverine woodland) without changing operators or losing continuity in guiding and service.

About Us | Tanzanian-Owned Safari Company | Acacia
About Acacia Collections Our Story
A legacy of extraordinary safari experiences, curated with passion and expertise across Tanzania s most spectacular wilderness destinations.
Meet Our Team
Awards & Recognition
About Us
Jambo!
Welcome to Acacia Collections
Acacia Collections is your ultimate destination for African safari adventures. We offer a selection of luxurious safari camps and lodges in two of Tanzania s premier wildlife destinations – Tarangire and Serengeti National Parks.
Our camps and lodges were designed to give you an immersive and unforgettable experience of Tanzania s diverse wildlife, culture, and natural beauty. We have played host to visitors from across the globe, providing an authentic experience that showcases not only the best of East African wildlife but that of our beautiful country and culture.
“ Born of his love for wildlife and passion for tourism, Peter s vision was to establish an authentically Tanzanian brand. ”
Our Story
From Guide to Leader
A Dream Born on the
Serengeti Plains
Acacia Collections is the culmination of the dream of a young man, Peter Robert, who started his career as a professional tour guide on the plains of the Serengeti.
Born of his love for wildlife and passion for tourism, Peter s vision was to establish an authentically Tanzanian brand while celebrating the age-old traditions of the classic African safari.
Having later achieved success in the business world, Peter brought his vision to life in 2015 in the form of then Serengeti Acacia Camps, to now, Acacia Collections.
2015
The year our journey began
Totally Tanzanian
100% Tanzanian-Owned
and Operated
As a proudly Tanzanian-owned and operated entity, we are committed to responsible resourcing and equitable redistribution of resources.
Valued Employer
A valued employer of local Tanzanian men and women, indirectly supporting hundreds of locals. We provide skills training for all staff, ensuring efficient, professional, and most importantly, friendly service.
Responsible Resourcing
We make every effort to source all products and consumables from local suppliers, to stimulate the economy. We believe that for Tanzania and its tourism industry to grow, it is vital to keep capital in the country.
Community & Conservation
We work closely with local communities to support sustainable tourism initiatives. We are committed to minimizing our environmental impact through waste reduction, water conservation, and wildlife conservation efforts.
Recognition
Totally Tanzanian
Reaping Rewards & Awards
Naturally, brand recognition is crucial to our success in the ultra-competitive East African safari industry. Since our inception, we have attracted the attention of both clients and competitors, carving our name deeply into the country s tourism consciousness. Accordingly, we have received several prestigious accolades, including:
As proud as we are of these achievements, it is the bonds we form with all our guests that matter most to us. No acknowledgement means more to us than sharing in the awe our guests experience when viewing wildlife in its natural habitat. Or in seeing those who arrive stressed, soon shed their cares. But most of all it is when – at the end of their journey – the parting words are, "We ll be back."
From Safari to Camps
An Authentic African
Adventure
From the moment our guests arrive, we strive to ensure that their experience of Africa leaves their memory banks filled with impressions that will stay with them forever.
A Warm Welcome
Guests are welcomed in song, with a refreshing cocktail symbolizing the start of their African adventure. Following a casual orientation of the camp and accommodation, it s time to settle in and adjust to the rhythm of Africa. Meals at our camps are a festive occasion, with either a barbeque or a buffet selection of both Tanzanian and contemporary dishes. As the moon arcs above, the air rings with traditional songs, punctuated by the myriad calls of the wild.
An Experience Like No Other
Tanzania s wildlife experience has few competitors across the continent. In the company of our friendly and experienced guides, we set off in custom-built safari vehicles as the sun illuminates the pristine landscape. Our guides delight in sharing their knowledge and experiences with their rapt audience. Be it the intense stalk of a lion, or the persistent efforts of a dung beetle, the fascinating web of Nature is always a treat to discover.
Comfort & Relaxation
Our camps are designed for comfort and relaxation, and our staff make every effort to ensure that all needs are met. Our guests are esteemed, and our guides and staff are all eager to share their country and their culture over dinner or drinks. Then as the embers of the campfire dim, you ll be escorted to your accommodation – secure in the knowledge that there is 24-hour assistance available if required.
Our Properties
The Collections
From Safari Camps
to Lodges
The Acacia Collections range of safari camps and lodges offer comfort and convenience in the heart of the African wilderness. Whether staying at our mobile migration camp or enjoying a luxurious stay at one of our lodges, you ll be surrounded by the sights and sounds of the African bush.
Our experienced guides and staff are dedicated to ensuring that your safari experience is unforgettable. We promise personalized service, delicious meals, and exciting activities that showcase the best of Tanzania. We are proud hosts to visitors from around the globe, fulfilling their dreams of seeing and feeling the wonders of our beautiful country.

Discover East Africa About Tanzania
A land of breathtaking landscapes, extraordinary wildlife, and warm hospitality — home to some of the most spectacular natural wonders on Earth.
The Land of Kilimanjaro
Welcome to Tanzania
Tanzania is East Africa s largest country and one of the most biodiverse nations on Earth. From the sweeping plains of the Serengeti to the pristine shores of Zanzibar, from the snow-capped summit of Kilimanjaro to the ancient caldera of the Ngorongoro Crater — Tanzania offers experiences found nowhere else on the planet.
With over 40% of its land area protected as national parks and reserves, Tanzania is a sanctuary for wildlife. The country hosts the largest population of wild animals in Africa and is one of the last places on Earth where vast herds of animals roam freely across open plains.

Iconic Destinations
Natural Wonders of Tanzania
From vast savannas to volcanic craters, Tanzania is home to some of the world s most spectacular landscapes and ecosystems.
14,750 km² of wilderness
Serengeti National Park
Home to the Great Migration — over 1.5 million wildebeest and hundreds of thousands of zebra traverse these endless plains in the world s largest overland migration.
600m deep caldera
Ngorongoro Crater
The world s largest intact volcanic caldera, sheltering over 25,000 large animals including the endangered black rhino. A UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1979.
5,895m above sea level
Mount Kilimanjaro
Africa s highest peak at 5,895 metres. This free-standing volcanic mountain draws climbers from around the world to its snow-capped summit on the equator.
50+ pristine islands
Zanzibar Archipelago
A spice island paradise with white-sand beaches, turquoise waters, and the historic Stone Town — a UNESCO World Heritage Site blending African, Arab, and Indian cultures.
Wildlife
A Kingdom of Wildlife
The Big Five
Lion, leopard, elephant, buffalo, and rhinoceros — all found in Tanzania s national parks.
Great Migration
Over 2 million animals migrate annually between the Serengeti and Kenya s Masai Mara.
800+ Bird Species
From flamingos at Lake Manyara to martial eagles soaring above the Serengeti.
Marine Life
Whale sharks, dolphins, and sea turtles along the Indian Ocean coast and Mafia Island.
Explore
Safari Destinations
Tanzania s Northern Circuit is home to the country s most iconic national parks and conservation areas.
Arusha
Tanzania s safari capital and gateway to the Northern Circuit, nestled at the foot of Mount Meru.
Tarangire National Park
The Land of Giants - famous for massive elephant herds, ancient baobab trees, and exceptional dry season wildlife viewing.
Ngorongoro Conservation Area
A UNESCO World Heritage Site featuring the world s largest intact volcanic caldera, teeming with wildlife.
Serengeti National Park
Tanzania s most iconic wildlife sanctuary, home to the Great Migration and unparalleled game viewing year-round.

Culture & People
The Heart of Tanzania
Tanzania is home to over 120 ethnic groups, each with their own traditions, languages, and customs. The Maasai, with their vibrant red shukas and deep connection to the land, are perhaps the most recognised, but Tanzania s cultural tapestry extends far beyond any single group.
Swahili — Tanzania s national language — is a bridge between these diverse communities and has become one of Africa s most widely spoken languages. The warmth and hospitality of the Tanzanian people, captured in the greeting "Karibu" (Welcome), makes every visitor feel at home.
